productFilms.title: ArchCanvas studio film
productFilms.summary: A product film whose picture is a coded replica of the ArchCanvas studio, not a screen recording. Four lengths by two aspect ratios, in two cuts, from one scene library.

productFilms.title: ArchLang film
productFilms.madeWith: Remotion, real compiler in the render
productFilms.summary: A coded replica of the ArchLang playground in which every floor plan is compiled during the render by the real compiler, with real command-line output and a synthesised soundtrack.

productFilms.title: echook film
productFilms.summary: A replica of the product's terminal interface that is a pure function of time, set in a procedurally painted watercolour world with a synthesised score.

productFilms.title: a11y-loop launch film
productFilms.summary: One full loop of the tool, plan, write, audit, fix and report, walked by a simulated keyboard, cursor and agent window. Written as code, a huashu-motion composition rendered frame by frame in Chrome, with a score composed in ABC notation and played by sampled instruments. Every command-line string on screen comes from real runs of a11y-loop 0.4.1 and every browser shot is a real screenshot of its demo page.

productFilms.title: GAVIGO IRE product film
productFilms.summary: The product interface recreated in code as a pure function of time and cut to measured downbeats.
productFilms.note: Product UI recreated in code; sequence shortened. Controlled measurements, not a production SLA.

productFilms.title: CORDE Mobile product film
productFilms.madeWith: Remotion, procedural watercolour map, synthesised score
productFilms.summary: A coded replica of the offline-first field app over a procedurally painted watercolour map, with a synthesised score and sound effects.
productFilms.note: The interface is a coded replica of the app. Every name and place shown is fictional.

productFilms.title: She Sharp product film
productFilms.madeWith: Remotion, coded UI replica, synthesised audio
productFilms.summary: The member platform's interface rebuilt in code, with gates that trace every on-screen string and figure to its source.

productFilms.title: Tam-AI-Ti product film
productFilms.summary: A coded replica of the product interface with procedural watercolour art and a synthesised score.
productFilms.note: Interface recreated in code for this film. Demo account and figures are illustrative.

productFilms.title: Eatropolis website film
productFilms.summary: The festival website's own interface rebuilt in code as a pure function of time, with gates that keep every frame true to the product.

productFilms.title: AI programming school product film
productFilms.summary: A coded replica of the free bilingual course site and its AI assistant.

films.title: ArchCanvas, the 92-second film
films.madeWith: HyperFrames, footage of one real product session
films.summary: A film with no voiceover, built from one continuous session on the live product. Music, sound design and text cards carry the argument, and five build gates enforce cleared copy and honest footage.

films.title: ArchCanvas «Zoom Out»
films.summary: One continuous zoom across the product's infinite canvas, told backwards. A silent film carried by text set in the canvas and one music bed, with four aspect ratios out of one edit.

films.title: echook, the first film
films.summary: The earlier promo, made when the product was still called claude-code-audio-hooks, with React-based animation, generated voice and sound effects, and a Suno score.

films.title: a11y-loop, the narrated film
films.madeWith: Remotion, figures captured from the real CLI
films.summary: A narrated film in which every number on screen is captured from the real command-line tool and gated by an automated verify step.

films.title: ArchLang one-take film
films.madeWith: three.js, Blender, recorded CC0 and public-domain instrument samples
films.summary: One take with no cuts. Lines of code become plan lines, the plan rises into a small 3D house, the house folds back into the plan, and the take ends on the logo. The code on screen is ArchLang's laneway-house example and the plan is its real compiler output; the house was modelled in Blender from that plan's geometry, for the film. A single three.js file draws every frame, and picture and score share one beat table.

series.title: ArchCanvas feature shorts
series.summary: Six 21 to 29 second shorts, one product feature each, cut from the same session on the live product as the 92-second film and reusing its on-screen copy word for word. Each exists in 16:9 and 9:16.

brandAndEvent.title: Chan Meng, 64-second video business card
brandAndEvent.summary: The brand monkey escorts eight on-screen facts about Chan's work, each one traced to the career database, painted in the sting's world and cut to a code-synthesised score.

brandAndEvent.title: Chan Meng monkey, brand sting
brandAndEvent.summary: A wordless sting for Chan's own mark. One orange pixel circles the monkey, bursts, and swirls back into a disc as the monkey settles into the exact logo. Every frame is a pure function of time.

brandAndEvent.title: Chan Meng, showreel
brandAndEvent.madeWith: p5.js, p5.brush, score played by sampled instruments
brandAndEvent.summary: Eleven projects, one print and one figure each. The brand monkey's pixel pins up a print in which the project's own finished film plays (for the two projects without a film, its animated README card or a screen capture of its site) and stamps one figure traced to the career database. Painted in the intro's world; the short cut shows the first five.

explainers.title: Liu Zhongjing in Watercolour
explainers.titleZh: 劉仲敬思想 · 水彩短片
explainers.summary: Fourteen short explainer films on the thought of the historian and political theorist Liu Zhongjing, one framework each, built as an argument in seven to thirteen chapters with Traditional Chinese captions. Every captioned quotation is verbatim from his writings, lectures and interviews and names its source on screen. Python paints the watercolour layers, a web page animates them as a pure function of time, headless Chrome captures every frame and ffmpeg adds the score.
explainers.credits: Ideas and quotations: Liu Zhongjing. Concept, painting engine, animation and scores by Chan Meng, built with Claude Code. Scores played back from recorded instruments (VSCO 2 Community Edition, Salamander Grand Piano, VCSL, Karoryfer) with a sampler adapted from the Lemo-Opuscar library (MIT); fonts LXGW WenKai TC and Noto Serif TC (SIL OFL). No image or video generation model, no photograph and no footage is used for the picture.

films.title: Roots
films.drawnAs: Order grows rather than being designed: roots spread under a tree, a village lights its lamps, dancers fall into step, and a grey wall rises to cut the field at the height it reached

films.title: Four Seasons
films.drawnAs: The seasons of a civilisation: feudal towers in spring, a free river town in summer, an imperial palace in autumn, fireworks of the golden age, lamps going out, a winter of scattered huts, riders from the steppe

films.title: Keeping the Seed
films.drawnAs: What survives the flood: a lamp in a snowbound monastery, a copyist at night, a clock tower speeding through the years, a man digging holes and planting trees, a walk through a blizzard, sprouts under melting snow

films.title: The Basin
films.drawnAs: Order flows like weather into a basin: rain runs down to a walled capital, caravans stream through a mountain gate, bronze vessels coarsen copy by copy, and a blue-green landscape in mineral pigment fades to monochrome ink

films.title: Scattered Sand
films.drawnAs: Atomised by design: clan compounds dissolve into identical huts, a lone tower stands on a dune beside a deep-rooted tree, a field of chives is cut and regrows, and a house of cards falls when a door opens

films.title: Invention
films.drawnAs: Nations are invented: a membrane forms around a crowd, a crown washes out of a throne, a river delta splits into colours, a boomerang comes back to its thrower, and many small walled towns line a river

films.title: The Footpath
films.drawnAs: Common law as a path trodden through the forest: an elder and a clerk under an oak, a market of precedents, a feudal contract with two equal seals, a duel crowd that becomes a jury, an empty throne

films.title: Blood Reward
films.drawnAs: Sovereignty from arms: spearmen round a council fire, a widow paid at a stone gate, a queen between merchant ships and graves, a farm wall growing into a fort, and a crop-dusted field where only the resistant weeds rise

films.title: The Black Box
films.drawnAs: Three generations of civilisation: lamps lit from a ziggurat eastward, a black box falling from a burning sky, a capsule that opens on a seed, caravans sailing a sea of grass, a cathedral growing from barbarian soil

films.title: The Carrot
films.drawnAs: His anti-self-help advice: a basket drifting past different doors, a donkey circling a millstone after a carrot, fourteen lamps lit among hundreds, a diver stepping off a jetty, a crumpled butterfly leaving its cocoon

films.title: Mould
films.drawnAs: Fervent belief as the producer of order: candles in a dark nave, mould ringing a dish so bacteria cannot enter, a hand wiping it away, a church granary feeding the poor, summer leaves over hidden roots, light reflected by the moon, a match girl in the snow, seeds through winter

films.title: The Ladder
films.drawnAs: Liberal education: copying before asking why, a go board, rows of examination desks, a seed holding its paths, a master and his apprentices, a page being erased, maps drawn for different purposes, a water spider skimming a pond, and a ladder climbing out of the dark

films.title: The Clan
films.drawnAs: Family and the small community: a clan courtyard, a household split into strangers, a net of kin, lanterns, a shared store of rice, a banyan whose roots make the grove, a wedding as an alliance, a jar of the grandchildren's rice, generations climbing, a child backstage

films.title: The Station
films.drawnAs: Nodes and founding: a valley that sets the path, a train riding the rails between stations, a sluice gate opened, a wager, a furrow ploughed round a new city, wandering scholars and rooted strongmen on the grass, an assembly of founders, and an oak for those who can wait

explainers.title: Liu Zhongjing's History, in Maps
explainers.titleZh: 劉仲敬史觀 · 地圖紀錄片
explainers.summary: Eleven animated map documentaries in three series, This Land (the East Asian mainland), The Republic (the People's Republic) and The World, that retell history as Liu Zhongjing reads it in ten to twelve chapters with Traditional Chinese captions. Every captioned quotation is verbatim and names its source on screen. A WebGL and Canvas globe built from Natural Earth data flies between regions, colours historical polities and draws campaigns, trade streams, walls and fronts; headless Chrome captures every frame and ffmpeg adds the score.
explainers.credits: Ideas and quotations: Liu Zhongjing. Concept, map renderer, animation and scores by Chan Meng, built with Claude Code. Map data from Natural Earth (public domain), drawn with d3-geo and topojson (ISC); present-day borders are a stage for historical regions, not a claim about sovereignty. Scores played back from recorded instruments (VSCO 2 Community Edition, Salamander Grand Piano, VCSL, Karoryfer) with a sampler adapted from the Lemo-Opuscar library (MIT); fonts LXGW WenKai TC and Noto Serif TC (SIL OFL). No image or video generation model, no photograph and no footage is used for the picture.

films.title: Dawn of the Xia States
films.drawnAs: This Land, c. 3300 BC to 660 BC: a broken, many-peopled mainland, chariots arriving from the steppe, Shang strongholds, Zhou military colonies, and the Xia states as islands in a barbarian sea

films.title: The Qin System
films.drawnAs: This Land, c. 450 BC to AD 220: commanderies spreading from the frontier, the registered household, the steppe answering, mercenaries marching and the grid falling apart

films.title: Order Imported from Inner Asia
films.drawnAs: This Land, 280 to 1912: from Yongjia and the Xianbei north through Sui-Tang, Liao, Jin, the Yuan provinces and the Ming to a Qing facing China from an Inner Asian base

films.title: The Xia States Speak
films.drawnAs: This Land, 1842 to 1949: the Royal Navy replacing Inner Asia as the source of order, provinces before the republic, and Wu-Yue, Ba-Shu, Hunan, Yunnan, Guangdong, Manchuria and Taiwan each lit with its own resources

films.title: The Branch
films.drawnAs: The Republic, 1920 to 1953: a small Comintern branch, money and discipline flowing from Moscow, the party-state template, the nodes of 1928 and 1937, and the Manchurian party

films.title: Gift Box and Bottomless Pit
films.drawnAs: The Republic, 1950 to 1972: Manchuria as a prize for Moscow, the 156 projects, the Third Front moving inland, the factions of the Cultural Revolution and the 1972 node

films.title: The Missing Middle
films.drawnAs: The Republic, 1972 to today: the sluice gate opened, the American order imported to the coast, special zones, round-tripped capital, migrant workers streaming to the coast, and the end of technology transfer

films.title: Where the Fire Started
films.drawnAs: The World, c. 3500 BC to 330 BC: the greater-Europe core and its four secondary zones, Sumerian city-states, chariots, the Indo-European waves and Persia

films.title: The Inner Asian Ocean
films.drawnAs: The World, 800 BC to AD 1500: Rome and Han, the Xiongnu, Sogdian caravans and the Sasanians, the Turks and the Mongols crossing a sea of grass, and the return of the sea route

films.title: The Seed Bank
films.drawnAs: The World, 376 to 1789: a church that would not die, the many-centred Latin world, Roman law spreading from Bologna, England as a seed of Germanic feudalism, and America as England's own seed

films.title: Two Bulls and a Frog
films.drawnAs: The World, 1842 to today: the British gold standard, two world wars, the dollar cycle and the Cold War, with two bulls fighting while a frog is trampled
